questions: What is your body temperature, and how many days have you had the fever?
Do you have chills, body aches, sore throat, cough, or skin rashes?
Have you taken any fever-reducing medicine like Paracetamol, and did it help?
redFlags: Fever above 103°F (39.4°C) that does not decrease with medicine
Stiff neck, severe headache, confusion, or convulsions
recommendations: Rest adequately, drink plenty of fluids (water, coconut water, soups), and sponge with lukewarm water. Do not self-prescribe heavy antibiotics.
source: Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) Health Advisories
